scripts.check:quick: npm run check && npm run check:px-values
scripts.check:feature: npm run check:quick && npm run test:unit && npm run build && npm run test:e2e:ui-guards && npm run test:e2e:critical
scripts.qa:release: npm run check:feature && npm run test:coverage && npm run test:e2e:admin && npm run test:e2e:legacy-parity
scripts.check:ui: npm run build && npm run test:e2e:ui-guards
scripts.test:e2e:admin: playwright test tests/admin-architecture.spec.ts tests/admin-backlog.spec.ts tests/admin-business.spec.ts tests/admin-packs.spec.ts tests/admin-waitlist.spec.ts tests/admin-wording.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:brand-system: npm run build && playwright test tests/brand-system.spec.ts
scripts.test:fx-lab: npm run build && playwright test tests/fx-lab.spec.ts
scripts.test:layout: npm run build && playwright test tests/home-layout.spec.ts --workers=1 && playwright test tests/brand-system.spec.ts --workers=1
scripts.test:legacy-parity: npm run build && playwright test tests/visual-compare.spec.ts
